verdict.headline: AMZN +14.9% seals 2-day recovery; September hike probability rises to 82%
verdict.label: Day 2 SPX regime reversal confirmed on Amazon's decade-best gain; bond market re-priced anyway — 30Y at 5.28%, September at 82.4%, 4 formal breaches active entering August
verdict.rationale_short: Amazon's 14.9% session — biggest single-day gain in over a decade — carried SPX to 7,467 for a second consecutive close above 7,380, formally completing the two-close BEARISH regime reversal. The rate environment moved the other direction: 30Y closed at 5.28% (+16bps, new 19-year high, 28bps above the 5.00% trigger), 10Y at 4.75% (+8bps), and September hike probability reached 82.4% — above the 70% formal threshold — after Q2 ECI printed at 0.9% QoQ (in-line), which fixed-income desks treated as insufficient dovish relief given Brent at ~$91/bbl and the FOMC's 9-3 dissent. If SPX closes below 7,380 any day next week, this read no longer holds.

trade_setups.thesis: Two consecutive closes above 7,380 formally completed the BEARISH regime reversal. The level that maintains the reversal: sustained closes above 7,380. The level that breaks it: any close below 7,380 re-activates the formal BEARISH regime. PLTR earnings AH Monday and July NFP August 7 are the two most likely catalysts to test this level in the near term.
trade_setups.entry: 7,380 is the new support; 7,500+ sustained through NFP would signal August momentum
trade_setups.invalidation: Any close below 7,380 re-activates the formal BEARISH regime designation

trade_setups.thesis: 30Y at 5.28% moved +16bps on a day when ECI printed in-line at 0.9% — the rate move is not data-driven but policy-pricing-driven. The constellation of inputs (Brent $91, FOMC 9-3 dissent, September at 82.4%) has fixed-income desks pricing further tightening regardless of individual data points. July NFP (Aug 7) is the nearest catalyst to shift this; August 13 CPI is the second. The level that would clear the formal breach: 30Y retreating below 5.00% after a weak NFP print.
trade_setups.entry: 5.30% as next extension level to watch; 5.00% as the recovery gate
trade_setups.invalidation: 30Y retreating below 5.00% after a sub-80K NFP print would clear the formal regime breach

trade_setups.thesis: PLTR Q2 earnings AH Monday August 3 with options pricing ~15% swing. First DoD AI pure-play earnings post-US-Iran escalation. Key metrics: AIP commercial ARR growth, US commercial customer count, government contract expansion. DoD AI spending urgency elevated by the IRGC strike context. A miss + September at 82.4% creates a dual headwind (fundamentals + multiple compression); a beat + government expansion validates the DoD AI thesis that prior briefings have tracked.
trade_setups.entry: Watch AH print; $110-115 on a miss, $140+ on a strong beat and DoD contract expansion
trade_setups.invalidation: A revenue miss combined with soft government contract guidance removes the DoD spending thesis

bear_case: The two-close SPX rule is mechanical, not fundamental: the market reclaimed 7,380 twice on one week's earnings — MSFT and AMZN — not on a macro shift. September hike probability at 82.4% is fixed-income desks' clearest signal of where policy is going, and a 30Y at 5.28% historically compresses Nasdaq forward multiples over a 3-6 month lag. AAPL's structural miss and AMD's ~8% decline in a rally session signal that rate pressure is already differentiating winners from the rest. If August 7 NFP prints above 150k, September becomes near-certain, the 30Y extends through 5.40%, and SPX loses 7,380 on Day 1 of August. The read no longer holds if SPX closes below 7,380.
